course.title: Engineering Economy
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: Apple computer wants to have \$2.1 billion available 5 years from now to finance production of a handheld “electronic brain" that based on your behavior, will learn how to control nearly all the electronics device in your home, such as the thermostat, coffee pot, TV etc.. The company expects to set aside uniformly increasing amounts of money each year to meet the goal. If the amount set aside at the end of year 1 is \$ 50 million, how much will the constant increase G have to be each year? Assume the investment account grows at a rate of 18% per year.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
